blocks.content: Unity of command states that an employee should receive orders from one superior only to avoid confusion and conflict.

items: Matrix organization violates Henri Fayol's principle of Unity of Command due to dual reporting lines (functional manager and project manager).
F.W. Taylor introduced Functional Foremanship, recommending 8 specialized foremen for planning and execution roles.
A narrow span of control creates a tall organizational structure, whereas a wide span leads to a flat structure.
Authority can be delegated to subordinates, but ultimate responsibility and accountability remain with the superior.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Line organization is the oldest and simplest structural form, characterized by direct scalar authority flowing from top to bottom.
Functional structure groups organizational activities based on key functions and specialized skills, as championed by F.W. Taylor.
Matrix organizational structure combines functional and project management approaches, resulting in dual reporting structures.
Span of control dictates the specific number of subordinates a manager can supervise effectively.
Centralization concentrates decision-making at top management levels, while decentralization distributes authority throughout all levels.
